name: Frozen Mountain Pass
author: voodoo573
description: A snowy pass between two rocky ridges. A trodden path runs east to west, crossed by a frozen stream. A rock outcrop, snowy pines and loose boulders provide cover. 24 x 18 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Snowy mountain pass with path, frozen stream and pines.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
